profile.headline: Senior Embedded Software Engineer specializing in production software development for embedded devices at TCI.
profile.summary:
As an Embedded Software Engineer at TCI International, my role is centered on enhancing telecommunication systems through the integration of sophisticated digital signal processing and machine learning techniques. With a Master's degree in Electrical Engineering and a Machine Learning Engineer Nanodegree, I am committed to pushing the boundaries of embedded software capabilities.

Recognized as a Dean's Scholar, my academic journey underscores a relentless pursuit of technological excellence and a passion for tackling intricate signal processing challenges. Our team has pioneered robust and efficient solutions, reinforcing TCI International's reputation in the telecom industry.

I persuade about one hundred and sixty students to vote for the campaign through classroom presentation, tabling and on-campus meetings.

projects.title: Deep RL Quadcopter Controller
projects.description: I implemented the Actor-Critic deep reinforcement learning algorithm to train a quadcopter flay from one position to another. The quadcopter successfully learns to take off from an initial position to a high verticle position.

projects.title: Creating Customer Segments
projects.description: The primary goal of the project is to implement various clustering algorithms on a dataset and analyze the data. I performed pre-processing steps like outlier detection along with clustering algorithms like Gaussian Model Mix, Principle Component Analysis, Biplot, and dimensionality reduction. I analyzed each algorithm thoroughly, and also included the discussion and visualization of the performance of the algorithms.

organizations.name: Project Management Institute (PMI)
organizations.description: I am a member of PMI to learn more about the emerging practices in project management. Also, I am interested in gaining a CAPM certificate from PMI.
